scripts.build:demo: rm -rf .next out && NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=/demo npm run build
scripts.build:demo-test: rm -rf .next out && NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=/demo-test npm run build
scripts.test:hierarchical: npm exec tsc -- --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target es2020 --lib dom,dom.iterable,esnext --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --outDir node_modules/.cache/map-demo-hierarchical-tests --rootDir . --incremental false tests/hierarchical-model.test.ts src/model/*.ts src/model/algorithms/*.ts src/io/*.ts src/networks/hierarchical_paper_toy.ts && node --test $PWD/node_modules/.cache/map-demo-hierarchical-tests/tests/hierarchical-model.test.js
scripts.deploy: npm run build:demo && rsync -avz out/* mapequation:/var/www/demo/
scripts.deploy-test: npm run build:demo-test && rsync -avz out/* mapequation:/var/www/demo-test/
